titre: Courses payantes des robotaxis par semaine
sous_titre: Milliers de courses payantes par semaine, de mai 2024 à mars 2026

mai 2024.texte: the company's average weekly paid robotaxi trips have grown tenfold, from 50,000 per week in May 2024

avril 2025.texte: Waymo hit a major milestone with 250,000 paid rides per week

mars 2026.texte: Waymo is now providing 500,000 paid robotaxi rides every week across 10 U.S. cities
